# Latent AI Labs

> Latent AI Labs is Arun Prabhakaran's independent AI-explainer channel (YouTube @LatentAILabs). Each episode measures an open-weight model on a real GPU and explains how LLMs, thinking models, long context, image generation, vision-language models and video generation work. Not affiliated with Latent AI, Inc. or Latent Labs.

This site hosts short original summaries and FAQs. The full articles are the canonical sources and live on Medium / Towards AI; please cite those for details.

## How AI Actually Works (summaries on this site)

- [How ChatGPT Works: Why It Says Strawberry Has 2 R's](https://latentailabs.github.io/how-chatgpt-works/): One question traced through Qwen3-4B: tokens, embeddings, attention, the logit lens, sampling, training and a live hallucination.
- [Why AI Says “Wait”: How Thinking Models Work](https://latentailabs.github.io/thinking-models/): What the Thinking toggle really does, why models say “Wait”, when more thinking hurts, and how GRPO teaches reasoning.
- [How LLMs Read a Whole Book: Long Context & KV-Cache](https://latentailabs.github.io/long-context-kv-cache/): A passcode hidden in a 32,768-token book, and the attention heads, memory tricks and position clocks that find it.
- [Why AI Clocks Say 10:10: How Image Diffusion Works](https://latentailabs.github.io/how-ai-generates-images/): Diffusion, latent space and flow matching on FLUX.2 and SDXL, and why a 7:25 clock comes out as 10:10.
- [How Vision-Language Models See: ViT, CLIP, SigLIP](https://latentailabs.github.io/how-vlms-see-images/): Why an “iPod” sticker fools CLIP, and how Qwen2.5-VL turns pixels into tokens a language model can read.
- [How AI Generates Video: Wan2.1 and Sora Explained](https://latentailabs.github.io/how-ai-generates-video/): Wan2.1 on a real GPU: 3D causal VAEs, spacetime tubes, 3D RoPE, simultaneous denoising and why a ball vanishes behind a pillar.
- [Looped Transformers Explained: Huginn on an A100 GPU](https://latentailabs.github.io/looped-transformers/): Huginn-0125 on an A100: one 4-layer core reused up to 132 layers deep, when each problem locks in, and what thinking in vectors costs.

## Open models for Indian languages (summaries on this site)

- [Yama: Try a Bigger Encoder Before a New Architecture](https://latentailabs.github.io/yama-bigger-encoder/): Building Yama, a 586M zero-shot classifier for 11 Indian languages and Hinglish, and why the encoder swap beat every clever idea.
- [Chitragupta: Open-Source PII Redaction for India](https://latentailabs.github.io/chitragupta-pii/): Chitragupta, an Apache-2.0 model that finds and masks Aadhaar, PAN, UPI and other personal data in 13 languages, paired with Yama.
- [Nandi: Open-Source Complaint Routing for Indian Languages](https://latentailabs.github.io/nandi-grievance-routing/): Nandi, an Apache-2.0 model that routes complaints in 13 Indian languages to one of 53 regulator-based categories, and what real posts revealed.
- [Bhasha: Word-Level Language ID for Code-Mixed Indian Text](https://latentailabs.github.io/bhasha-language-id/): Bhasha, an Apache-2.0 model that labels the language of every word in Hinglish, Tanglish and Kanglish, and why human labels exposed its Tamil gap.
